title: untrusted_stripped
description: A read of GitHub content dropped text by untrusted authors, or refused an untrusted issue, pull request or comment outright. Written by callum-flow-issue-read. A security trail: the dropped text itself is never logged.

source.description: What was being read: an issue, a pull request or a comment (refused whole), or an issue's comments, its timeline or an issue list (items dropped).

refused.description: true: the whole item was refused because its author is untrusted; false: untrusted items were dropped from it.

count.description: How many items were dropped; null when refused.

pr.description: The pull request read, when it was one.
